QuestInfo.name: The Mixed Golem Threat
QuestInfo.0: Go see Rina, who apparently sneaks into the Golem's Temple under the full moon. As bizarre as that is, she might have seen something important.
QuestInfo.1: Rina goes to the Golem's Temple when the full moon is out to pick Primroses to make her soaps and tea with. It's full moon tomorrow, and she wants to go to the temple, but she says the Mixed Golems have been growing more dangerous. She'd like you to eliminate 60 Mixed Golems for her. Report to Dr. Bruce once you finish eliminating the Mixed Golems.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the dangerous Mixed Golems, and went back to Dr. Bruce with your findings.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 2,500 #Wbasic# #i1002159:# #t1002159:# x 1 Can proceed to the Mixed Mutation quest

0.0: Hello! I wasn't doing anything suspicious! What are you looking at me like that?!\r\n#L0##bI know things! Things like you sneaking into the Golem's Temple every full moon!#l\n#k
0.1: Gasp! Wait, did I just say gasp? I did, I'm going to stick with it. Well I don't know why you care about what I'm doing late at night. I'll have you know that temple has the BEST Primroses this side of the Singing Mushroom Forest. They bloom so pretty when the moon is full!\\r\n#L0##bThat was not as exciting as I'd hoped. I'll just be going now...#l\n#k
0.2: Not! So! Fast! You've been snooping around about me behind my back. You owe me one! As luck would have it, tomorrow is the full moon and those Mixed Golems at the temple have been a real pain lately! You go down to the Golem's Temple 2 and beat them up for me so that I can go in and get my darling Primroses! Then we'll be even.

yes.0: Just go beat up some Mixed Golems. They are super fun to beat up, I promise!

no.0: I'm so glad you didn't find out about the other stuff...

1.0: What did Pia tell you? Did she tell you to eat more Blue Mushmom Spores? They make you terribly paranoid. Did you know that? You already knew that and you're trying to make a fool of me, aren't you?!\r\n#L0##b Nope. She told me it was probably just a coincidence. Those spores ride the wind all over the place. But then she sent me to Rina and Rina guilt-tripped me into harassing a bunch of Mixed Golems.#l\n#k
1.1: Rina?! Does Rina know something about me?! She's out to get me!\r\n#L0##bCalm down, doc! She just goes to the Golem's Temple to get Primroses under the full moon.#l\n#k
1.2: Primroses? They think they're so much better than regular roses. I like to call them Snootyroses behind their backs! That's what they get for plotting against me. I wonder if there's a connection between those Snootyroses and the Golem Temple...

yes.0: Hmm, there must be something here, and that's not just the Mushmom spores talking. Snootyroses are very hard to find. They absorb the energy of the earth and explode into bloom under the full moon. They're very mysterious, they must be plotting to absorb the world!

npc.0: Just go out there and beat up 60 Mixed Golems. It's going to be a blast!

mob.0: Did Pia tell you anything? You have to tell me if she did.
